name: Relax: MR Zen Bubbles
summary:
There are no points, no lives. This is not a game. Just chill out and vibe with this mellow low-key experience on Meta Quest 3.
This is not a multiplayer game, though the feature may be added later if there is enough demand.
No network connection is required and no data is collected.
Camera permissions are used to make the bubble reflections look nicer and are optional.
AI was not used in the creation of this experience.
Support: zenbubbles@practicallysoftware.com
